items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Yeah, I used to go there and play in his place.

ctx.x: Go down low, too. What kind of tone did they have? Well, they had good tone. They had good tone. Yeah.

And they could phrase good and everything? Oh, yeah. They had good tone. Now, I thought they called a diet, and he had a nice tone, too. Well, they used to play in the district there. Oh, I don't know, I forgot his name. I used to play in his place there, in the district. You used to play in his place? Yeah, I played in Jimmy. Jimmy used to play while in that, in the district, I don't know. Yeah, I used to go there and play in his place. What place was this? I called him Franklin, between, Franklin between,…
This is reel four of Tom Albert, May the 7th, 1962. Now we're talking about that corner player. He used to go take Kolaos.
